headline: Export opportunities for Dominican products according to ProDominicana
summary: ProDominicana identified 196 Dominican products with export opportunities, with European countries concentrating demand for many of them. Director Vladimir Pimentel presented the findings in Santo Domingo.
why: Export diversification affects the Dominican Republic's trade balance, foreign currency earnings and the competitiveness of its producers.
original_headline: Oportunidades de exportación para productos dominicanos según ProDominicana
